Mitigation: rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0, the most recent version that was healthy in production, in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rollback verified as rolled_out. args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Investigation**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1, unhealthy in all three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. The release history showed v2.3.1 was unhealthy, while v2.3.0 was the most recent healthy production release.
2. **Rollback**: Rolled checkout-api back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback completed and was verified as rolled out.
3. **Incident**: Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** ("checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks — rolled back to v2.3.0"), which paged the on-call engineer. It documents the v2.3.1 health check failures, the 18% error rate, and the mitigation performed. Root cause of the v2.3.1 failure remains to be investigated.
